summary: Nora no longer starts a second note with a title that is already open, and no longer creates an extra note when an update could belong to two.
details: Asking Nora to note something under a title that an open note already has now points her to that note to update, instead of starting a duplicate.
When the background pass that reads the room finds an update whose title matches two open notes, it holds the update instead of creating a third note. Before, every such update added another copy.
limitations: A held update is kept but not applied until the two notes are merged; nothing merges them automatically yet.
